asyncAppend's mapper parameter was typed as unknown because
Parameters<> collapses the generic render<T>() method it delegates
to. Give the exported function an explicit generic signature, the
same pattern already used by guard(), so the mapper's value
parameter is inferred from the async iterable's element type.

Fixes #4819
